lastCompletedStory.title: Collapse the cam-review template and drop subagent-reviewer from the orch Task allowlist

nextStoryContext: US-005 is the doc/hook-side collapse of the review path: cam-review.md (both templates/ and .claude/ copies, previously byte-identical, kept byte-identical) is now a thin phase:review signal-writer note mirroring cam-ship.md's shape exactly (front matter model:, CLI-path paragraph, slash-command-path paragraph, '## Write the signal' yaml block, '## Narrate' block quoting the actual narrateReviewPhaseResult push-line shape '[cam] review round complete: ...' / 'failed: ...'). subagent-reviewer was removed from all 3 locations in orch-agent-allowlist.sh (header comment allowlist line, case arm, error-message helper list) in BOTH the templates/.claude/ and .claude/ copies (these two were byte-identical pre-edit and stayed byte-identical post-edit -- verified with diff). templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (+ its .claude/ mirror, which carries PRE-EXISTING unrelated drift from templates/ -- missing the .cam-sidecar-stalled.json marker section and an older suggestions-promote text; that drift was NOT touched, only the subagent-reviewer/cam-review passages were edited in lockstep on top of it) was rewritten in 6 spots: (1) the Identity bullet's allowlist enumeration + a new sentence noting review now uses the same phase:review signal-writer model as implement; (2) the conversation-contract table's 'review' row (was 'self-invoke via Skill tool', now 'spawn /cam-review, sidecar runs it, narrate the pushed line'); (3) the Dispatch protocol's Signal-writers/Inject-commands split (cam review MOVED from 'Inject commands' into 'Signal-writers' -- cam issue is now the ONLY inject command left); (4) the '### Signal-writing commands' step list (now 'plan, next, review, ship') and the renamed '### Inject commands: issue' step list (issue only); (5) the 'Implementer and reviewer workers' section, rewritten so the reviewer paragraph describes an interactive TUI claude session in the titled 3rd pane spawned by makeReviewDispatch on phase:review, never via Task -- NOTE: the oracle for this file is `! grep -q 'subagent-reviewer'` (bare identifier, zero occurrences anywhere including asides), so every reference had to be reworded to 'the reviewer worker' rather than naming the literal agent-type string, even in explanatory clauses; (6) the Sidecar-model section's step 2 (cam-review moved from the 'runs directly in your context' clause to the phase-signal clause alongside plan/ship). test/orch-agent-allowlist.test.ts's 'scoped: subagent-reviewer yields allow' case was flipped to 'yields deny' and re-homed under the DENY block -- this is a MUST, not optional, per the new patterns.md bullet: a hook-behavior regression test is not derived from the hook's own source text, so a stale allow-assertion stays green-for-the-wrong-reason after just editing the case arm. embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check + full check:all (5421 tests) all green. The subagent-reviewer AGENT ITSELF (templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, src/supervisor/review.ts's DEFAULT_REVIEWER_AGENT constant, buildReviewerWorkerArgv) is UNTOUCHED and still very much alive -- it is dispatched as a TUI worker pane by makeReviewDispatch, exactly like the implementer; only its Task()-in-orchestrator-context spawn path and its literal-string mentions in the allowlist/orchestrator-doc prose were removed. No external library was touched (docs/hook/agent-md/test-only story).
